subject: Performance deep-dive demo — finalize slot & runbook prep
messages:
From: Sarah Khan <sarah.khan@acme.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: acme-eng@acme.com
Date: Wed, 1 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood perf demo — availability and scope

Hi Connor,

Thanks for coordinating. We7d like a focused 60-minute technical demo and benchmarking walkthrough for our infra and ML teams. Primary goals: validate sustained token throughput for short-chat workloads, understand p95 latency under target batching, and review fallback behavior when a model variant is swapped.

Preferred week: Dec 6-10 (PST). Ideal attendees from our side: myself (PM), Timothy (eng), and two SREs (acme-eng distribution). We can provide a representative prompt set and an initial CSV of token targets.

Can you confirm what of your runbook and loadtest artifacts you7ll share ahead of time? Also, do you need any telemetry access from our side?

Attaching: token_targets.csv (summary).

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Khan
Product Manager, Acme Platform
[attachment: token_targets.csv (CSV, 12KB)]

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Khan <sarah.khan@acme.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, acme-eng@acme.com
Date: Wed, 1 Dec 2027 12:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood perf demo — availability and scope

Sarah, thanks — perfect. Proposed plan: 60-minute session with 40 minutes for live demo + load test results and 20 minutes for Q&A/action items. We7ll share the perf_runbook_v2.pdf and a short agenda at least 48 hours ahead.

Slot options (PST):
- Tue Dec 7, 10:00-11:00
- Wed Dec 8, 13:00-14:00
- Thu Dec 9, 09:00-10:00

Can you confirm which slot works? Also tagging Laura who will own the runbook walkthrough and Marcus for benchmarking details. Dylan will manage the calendar/invite and the live telemetry link.

A few quick clarifying questions so we can tailor the demo:
1) Do you want us to run a sustained 30-minute throughput test during the meeting, or present pre-run artifacts? (We can do live short bursts; long sustained runs are better run earlier and shared results.)
2) Token size distribution: are your prompts majority short (<=64 tokens) or mixed?
3) Any strict p95 SLA target we should try to demonstrate? (e.g., p95 < 150ms for chat requests)

I7ll prep the runbook and agenda and upload them to the shared Drive.

Cheers,
Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Sarah Khan <sarah.khan@acme.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, acme-eng@acme.com
Date: Thu, 2 Dec 2027 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood perf demo — availability and scope

Looping in more detail on the runbook. We7ll share perf_runbook_v2.pdf (attached) which contains:
- test harness configuration (load generator, concurrency model)
- model variants to try (rw-4b-chat, rw-4b-chat-quant, rw-13b-shard)
- KV/prefix cache settings and batching knobs we7ll toggle
- telemetry endpoints and sample dashboards (read-only link)

Connor: recommend we pre-run two 30-minute tests (one for short-chat, one mixed) and present the summarized graphs during the session. That avoids running long tests live and lets us focus on interpretation and fallbacks. Marcus, can you confirm you have capacity to run both pre-runs on Dec 6?

Attaching agenda draft: acme_demo_agenda.md and the runbook PDF.

Thanks,
Laura
Senior Product Manager, Redwood Console
[attachment: acme_demo_agenda.md (Markdown, 4KB)]
[attachment: perf_runbook_v2.pdf (PDF, 85KB)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Sarah Khan <sarah.khan@acme.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, acme-eng@acme.com
Date: Fri, 3 Dec 2027 10:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood perf demo — availability and scope

Laura/Connor/Sarah,

I can run the pre-runs on Monday Dec 6. Quick notes on targets so we7re aligned:
- Short-chat workload: target sustained 1,200 tokens/sec (aggregate across two workers), p95 < 200ms
- Mixed workload: target sustained 900 tokens/sec, p95 < 250ms
- Memory/kv note: for rw-13b-shard we7ll test with KV cache warm and cold to show latency deltas

Infrastructure ask from Acme: a small allowlist for telemetry IPs and a temporary API key for the test harness (read-only for telemetry) so we can push metrics to our dashboard. If you can provide the sample prompt set by EOD Dec 4, that helps tune the batcher and kv prefetch thresholds.

I7ll upload raw results and a short summary (PDF) to the Drive and link it in the invite.

Marcus
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Khan <sarah.khan@acme.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 6 Dec 2027 15:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Performance deep-dive demo — finalize slot & runbook prep

Thanks everyone — slot confirmed.

Calendar invite: Wed Dec 8, 13:00-14:00 PST (30-60 min hold, final 60).
Meeting link + read-only dashboards: https://meet.redwood.ai/r/perf-acme
Drive folder: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/Perf/ACME/runbook
Attachments included in the invite: perf_runbook_v2.pdf, acme_demo_agenda.md, token_targets.csv, token_targets_summary.pdf

Action items before the session:
- Acme: share final prompt set (Sarah) by EOD Dec 4.
- Redwood: Marcus to upload pre-run summaries by Dec 6 (done).
- Redwood: Laura to publish runbook and short agenda 48 hours prior.

On Wed we7ll do a short live demo, run through the summarized pre-run graphs, then leave time for p95/distribution questions and next-step recommendations (quantization, burst policies).

Ryan (SRE) from Acme asked about a temporary read-only API key; Connor will coordinate secure exchange via our KMS-approved channel.

See you all there.

Dylan
Solutions Operations, Redwood Inference
